name: story-ring
title: Story ring
description: An avatar with a ring that says whether a story is new, seen or live, as a button that opens it, plus a snapping row with your own slot.
docs: StoryRing wraps the house Avatar in a ring with a gap and is one button. state is unseen (a bold solid ring), seen (a thin muted ring), live (a dashed ring with a small Live tag) or none (no ring). The picture keeps its size in all four, so a row stays level, and the ring never depends on colour: weight, dashes and a word carry it. The button is named after the person and their state, 'Maya, new story', 'Maya, story seen', 'Maya, live now', labels replaces those words, and label replaces the whole name. src falls back to the initials of name when it is missing or fails to load. size is sm, md or lg (48, 64 and 80px). onOpen is called when it is pressed. showName writes the name under the ring inside the button, so the two are one target; badge puts a small mark on the bottom right. StoryRingRow is a sideways-scrolling list named Stories that snaps ring by ring: items is a list of { id, name, src, state } and onOpen receives the person. you adds the viewer's own slot first: Your story with a plus when state is none (onAdd), and the ring when they have a story (onOpen). With a mouse, small arrows appear at the ends that can still be scrolled, and smooth scrolling is turned off under reduced motion.
